    custom_profile = {
        "structured_output": True,
        # ...

    model = init_chat_model("...", profile=custom_profile)
    ```

    ```typescript
    const customProfile: ModelProfile = {
        structuredOutput: true,
        // ...
    }
    const model = await initChatModel("...", { profile: customProfile });
    ```
"},{"ref":"n13","start":5048,"end":5160,"text":"    If tools are specified, the model must support simultaneous use of tools and structured output.
</Tip>
:::

"},{"ref":"n14","start":5182,"end":5362,"text":"Some model providers support structured output natively through their APIs (e.g. OpenAI, xAI (Grok), Gemini, Anthropic (Claude)). This is the most reliable method when available.

"},{"ref":"n16","start":14495,"end":14764,"text":"### Stream with human-in-the-loop (HITL) interrupts

When building interactive agents with human-in-the-loop workflows, you can use [event streaming](/oss/langgraph/event-streaming) to consume message chunks and state snapshots concurrently while handling interrupts.

"},{"ref":"n17","start":15259,"end":15643,"text":"- **`stream.messages`**: Chat-model output as content blocks; iterate each `message.text` for token deltas. For nested subgraphs, read message chunks from `stream.subgraphs[*].messages`.
- **`stream.values`**: Full state snapshots after each step
- **`stream.interrupted` / `stream.interrupts`**: After each run, check whether the graph paused; read payloads from `stream.interrupts`
"},{"ref":"n18","start":15643,"end":15777,"text":"- **`Command(resume=...)`**: Pass as the next `stream_events` input to resume; loop until the run completes without interrupting
:::

"},{"ref":"n19","start":15820,"end":16199,"text":"- **`stream.messages`**: Chat-model output as content blocks; iterate `message.text` for token deltas. For nested subgraphs, read message chunks from `stream.subgraphs[*].messages`.
- **`stream.values`**: Full state snapshots after each step
- **`stream.interrupted` / `stream.interrupts`**: After each run, check whether the graph paused; read payloads from `stream.interrupts`
"},{"ref":"n20","start":16199,"end":16332,"text":"- **`Command(resume=...)`**: Pass as the next `streamEvents` input to resume; loop until the run completes without interrupting
:::

"},{"ref":"n21","start":18585,"end":18806,"text":"One of the most common uses of interrupts is to pause before a critical action and ask for approval. For example, you might want to ask a human to approve an API call, a database change, or any other important decision.
